Bristol medtech Halcyon acquires Sheffield startup Podmap

Halcyon, a Bristol-based medtech group, has acquired Podmap, a Sheffield startup founded in 2022 that makes foot-pressure sensors for diabetics.

Podmap's twelve employees will join Halcyon's product team, and its sensor technology will be folded into Halcyon's existing monitoring platform.

The financial terms of the acquisition were not disclosed, though Podmap had raised £800,000 in a pre-seed round from regional angels before the deal.
